hypothesis: Replace uniform token-block choice with Token-level Adaptive Candidate Sampling: estimate which eligible SeqFlow blocks most strongly control each evaluated anchor's inverse-decoded token sequence, then preferentially perturb those high-importance blocks while preserving bounded nonzero sampling support for every eligible block. This should spend more of the fixed proposal work on structurally effective local coordinates and expose a more distinct de novo pool to the unchanged Thompson selector.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: Gaussian-process posterior Thompson selection over a freshly generated trust-region candidate pool
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only SeqFlow training plus a task-local latent Gaussian process fit only to oracle-evaluated molecule-score pairs
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: evaluated-anchor trust-region perturbation of latent token blocks followed by inverse-flow de novo decoding
method_tags.representation: SELFIES token sequences mapped to an exactly reconstructible continuous latent space by an autoregressive normalizing flow

activation_observables.measurement: For every anchor used in a proposal round, record each eligible token block's anchor-specific TACS pointwise-mutual-information importance, its bounded normalized sampling probability, and every selected block. Across all generated latent points, report both the probability-weighted expected importance and the realized selected-block importance minus the uniform-over-eligible-blocks importance baseline. Compare with Parent n-5e9392f126c0, whose configured block probabilities are uniform and therefore have zero configured importance lift; require positive aggregate configured and realized lift on anchor-rounds with non-tied importance scores, while retaining the existing decode-yield counters as supporting diagnostics.

applicability_conditions: The fixed SeqFlow must continue to exactly encode and inverse-decode objective-session molecules, because TACS estimates block importance by bounded interventions on an evaluated anchor's existing latent blocks.

Eligible token blocks must have heterogeneous anchor-specific structural influence: perturbing some blocks must change more of the inverse-decoded anchor sequence than perturbing others, so adaptive probabilities can differ meaningfully from uniform sampling.

Representation-level block influence must be a useful proxy for producing distinct local molecules from high-scoring evaluated anchors; the mechanism does not claim that influence alone identifies objective-improving chemistry.

The bounded probability floor keeps every eligible block reachable, so the change remains applicable when the importance estimate is noisy or when multi-block interactions matter, but it may underperform when single-block interventions are uninformative about joint perturbations.

The extra batched inverse decodes used to estimate per-anchor importance must remain feasible under the supplied runtime profile; no additional oracle calls, corpus retrieval, online representation training, or evaluator-side information is required.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if anchor-rounds with non-tied TACS importance still configure uniform eligible-block probabilities, or if their aggregate probability-weighted and realized selected-block importance fails to exceed the corresponding uniform-selection baseline; a lower score with positive importance lift would instead mean the mechanism activated but was not useful.
research_intent.implementation_change: Change only token-block selection inside _fresh_candidate_pool. Once per proposal round, use the frozen SeqFlow inverse path to make seeded single-block interventions for each eligible block of each current evaluated anchor, compare the resulting token sequence with that anchor, and derive an anchor-specific pointwise-mutual-information importance score. Convert those scores through a temperature-controlled softmax mixed with a fixed uniform probability floor, then pass the resulting probabilities to the existing without-replacement block draw. Keep anchor ranking, selected-block count, displacement distribution and magnitude, trust radii, duplicate and validity rejection, candidate-pool bounds, exact latent GP, Thompson acquisition, feedback updates, protocol, and all fallbacks unchanged, and emit the registered importance-lift diagnostic.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace uniform token-block choice with Token-level Adaptive Candidate Sampling: estimate which eligible SeqFlow blocks most strongly control each evaluated anchor's inverse-decoded token sequence, then preferentially perturb those high-importance blocks while preserving bounded nonzero sampling support for every eligible block. This should spend more of the fixed proposal work on structurally effective local coordinates and expose a more distinct de novo pool to the unchanged Thompson selector.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 uniformly sampled all eligible token blocks even though its seed-0 proposal logs show that 335,178 of 365,802 latent points (91.63%) inverse-decoded to the unchanged anchor, only 24,721 points (6.76%) entered a unique valid acquisition pool, and 66 of 145 rounds reached the 4,096-attempt guard. The waste was most severe on median_2, where 99,697 of 104,863 points were unchanged, unique-pool yield was 4.09%, only 7 of 127 recorded anchor transitions improved their source anchor, and terminal Top-1 rose by just 0.02328; the method therefore needs to direct the same bounded perturbations toward token blocks that actually influence the decoded molecule.

applicability_conditions: The exact-representation prerequisite held in the formal replica: Candidate and Parent use the identical prepared SeqFlow content hash, all 150 Candidate objective-session round-trip records have token and canonical rates 1.0, and the final records cover 1,500/1,500 exact token and canonical reconstructions with zero representation failures.

Anchor-specific influence heterogeneity held almost everywhere under this representation and intervention: 1,158/1,160 anchor-round profiles were non-tied and accounted for 300,435/300,683 generated points. The two tied profiles used uniform probabilities, so applicability includes a safe local fallback but not useful steering when many profiles are tied.

The bounded-support condition held exactly: all profile probability vectors were normalized within 3.774758283725532e-15, no probability fell below its declared 0.20/n floor, and all 680,229 selected blocks were eligible and unique within their without-replacement draw. Every eligible coordinate therefore remained reachable.

The evidence supports representation-level distinctness, not objective utility. Aggregate unique-valid yield rose from 0.0675802756682577 to 0.08745090344316107 and unchanged-anchor rate fell from 0.916282579100169 to 0.8933993607886046, but the terminal macro score fell and three of five tasks scored lower. Applications should not infer objective improvement from influence lift alone.

The added inverse-decode probes were operationally feasible under the supplied profile. The Candidate completed all five 300-call sessions in 379.8335008349968 seconds total; task wall times range from 27.564341482997406 to 117.00871474502492 seconds, well below the 3,600-second task timeout, and no extra oracle call was made.

The result is specific to seed 0, batch size 10, 29 adaptive rounds per task, up to eight evaluated anchors per round, the frozen SeqFlow representation, a 400.0 temperature, a 0.20 uniform mixture, and single-block interventions clipped at 3.0. Evidence does not establish behavior when joint interactions dominate, inverse decoding is not exact, or probe costs are material under a different runtime profile.

observable_measurements.name: tacs_token_block_selection_importance_lift
observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 uses uniform sampling over every eligible token block. Its source calls numpy_rng.choice without a probability vector, and all 145 formal seed-0 uniform_token_block_probability_deviation records report configured_probability_max_difference 0.0. Those records cover 365,802 generated points and 824,959 selected-block draws. Uniform probabilities make probability-weighted configured importance equal to the uniform-over-eligible-block baseline for any importance vector, so the Parent's configured importance lift is 0 by construction. The Parent does not estimate or log TACS anchor importance and therefore has no separately observed finite-sample realized-importance statistic; its registered realized reference is the uniform-selection baseline against which the Candidate's recorded selections are measured. Its supporting decode telemetry reports 335,178 unchanged-anchor decodes, 24,721 unique valid pool entries, aggregate yield 0.0675802756682577, and 66 rounds at the 4,096-attempt guard.
observable_measurements.value: The formal seed-0 Candidate contains all 145 expected proposal rounds, 29 on each of the five tasks. Every round logs eight anchor-specific TACS profiles, for 1,160 anchor-round profiles in total. Each profile records every eligible token-block id, its intervention-derived pointwise-mutual-information importance, its normalized configured probability, its uniform reference probability and floor, and its configured importance lift. The three profile arrays are aligned for all 1,160 profiles; their probability sums differ from 1.0 by at most 3.774758283725532e-15, and no configured probability is below its declared 0.20/n uniform floor. Of the 1,160 profiles, 1,158 have non-tied importance; every one of those 1,158 has a non-uniform probability vector and positive configured lift. Their configured-lift range is 0.0004427473898314105 to 18.883850253918, and their probability-span range is 0.00013128212672389866 to 0.0464334518714352. The two tied profiles correctly retain uniform probabilities. Consequently every one of the 145 rounds has positive aggregate configured lift, with its maximum configured-probability difference ranging from 0.002833696057423679 to 0.046433451871435244. The paired point-selection records cover every one of 300,683 generated latent points and all 680,229 selected-block draws. Independent profile-to-selection reconstruction found no missing anchor, ineligible block, duplicate block within a without-replacement draw, eligible-count mismatch, or round-count mismatch, and exactly reproduced each round's logged uniform, configured, and realized means. Restricting to the 300,435 points and 679,660 block draws whose anchor profile was non-tied, the draw-weighted uniform importance is 6.939564630248766, configured importance is 8.205344821961374, and realized selected-block importance is 8.138770544325107. Thus configured-minus-uniform lift is +1.2657801917126075 and realized-minus-uniform lift is +1.1992059140763407 on the pre-registered non-tied population. Across all points, including 248 points from tied profiles, the corresponding uniform, configured, and realized means are 6.936222775527095, 8.20094416361758, and 8.134425574233305, for configured and realized lifts of +1.2647213880904842 and +1.1982027987062103. Realized lift is positive in 136/145 rounds and negative in 9/145 because of finite sampling, but its draw-weighted aggregate is positive on every task: deco_hop +1.5003888542775927, drd2_docking +0.24432515030176585, median_2 +0.4973318137907245, sitagliptin_mpo +2.0559092145914377, and zaleplon_mpo +1.0914720471285126. The retained decode-yield diagnostics also move in the intended supporting direction in aggregate: the Candidate obtains 26,295 unique valid pool molecules from 300,683 latent points, yield 0.08745090344316107, versus the Parent's 24,721 from 365,802, yield 0.0675802756682577; unchanged-anchor decodes fall from 335,178/365,802 = 0.916282579100169 to 268,630/300,683 = 0.8933993607886046, and 4,096-attempt guard rounds fall from 66 to 48. All 145 Candidate rounds still fill their announced batch. The intended adaptive block-selection behavior therefore occurred and increased both configured and realized importance relative to uniform selection.

possible_failure_causes: Confirmed importance steering did not produce the pre-registered terminal-score benefit on this replica. The trusted seed-0 Candidate macro is 0.463509213350862 versus Parent 0.531102062096459, a paired difference of -0.06759284874559707. Candidate-minus-Parent Top-1 changes are +0.05766010820494222 on zaleplon_mpo, -0.011910182360748922 on deco_hop, -0.3835987172190932 on drd2_docking, -0.012902465236174304 on median_2, and +0.012787012883086035 on sitagliptin_mpo. The large docking loss dominates the aggregate and shows that structural influence is not by itself a reliable proxy for objective-improving chemistry.

The supporting distinct-pool effect is task-dependent. Candidate unique-valid yield improves on deco_hop, drd2_docking, median_2, and zaleplon_mpo, but falls on sitagliptin_mpo from 0.08876242804814233 to 0.07835953562429471, while that task's guard-round count rises from 8 to 12. Adaptive importance can therefore redirect work without uniformly improving decode efficiency in every evolving task trajectory.

Finite sampling sometimes opposes the configured preference: realized importance lift is negative in 9/145 rounds, including 6/29 drd2_docking rounds, even though every round has positive configured lift. The aggregate remains positive on every task, so this does not trigger the falsifier, but smaller pools or fewer draws could give less reliable realized steering.

The mechanism estimates each block from one seeded single-block replacement per anchor and round. Such a marginal intervention can be noisy and can miss joint block interactions; the observed two tied profiles and 248 points drawn from them demonstrate a small regime in which it supplies no adaptive ordering and correctly falls back to uniform probabilities.

The fixed temperature and 0.20 uniform mixture bound concentration but also limit steering when influence differences are weak. Among heterogeneous profiles the smallest probability span is only 0.00013128212672389866, so activation need not imply a practically large allocation change for every anchor.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. It establishes execution and positive aggregate configured and realized importance lift across the five formal task sessions, but not cross-seed stability, multi-seed score benefit, or transfer to other SeqFlow representations and objectives.

possible_failure_causes: Confirmed importance steering did not produce the pre-registered terminal-score benefit on this replica. The trusted seed-0 Candidate macro is 0.463509213350862 versus Parent 0.531102062096459, a paired difference of -0.06759284874559707. Candidate-minus-Parent Top-1 changes are +0.05766010820494222 on zaleplon_mpo, -0.011910182360748922 on deco_hop, -0.3835987172190932 on drd2_docking, -0.012902465236174304 on median_2, and +0.012787012883086035 on sitagliptin_mpo. The large docking loss dominates the aggregate and shows that structural influence is not by itself a reliable proxy for objective-improving chemistry.

The supporting distinct-pool effect is task-dependent. Candidate unique-valid yield improves on deco_hop, drd2_docking, median_2, and zaleplon_mpo, but falls on sitagliptin_mpo from 0.08876242804814233 to 0.07835953562429471, while that task's guard-round count rises from 8 to 12. Adaptive importance can therefore redirect work without uniformly improving decode efficiency in every evolving task trajectory.

Finite sampling sometimes opposes the configured preference: realized importance lift is negative in 9/145 rounds, including 6/29 drd2_docking rounds, even though every round has positive configured lift. The aggregate remains positive on every task, so this does not trigger the falsifier, but smaller pools or fewer draws could give less reliable realized steering.

The mechanism estimates each block from one seeded single-block replacement per anchor and round. Such a marginal intervention can be noisy and can miss joint block interactions; the observed two tied profiles and 248 points drawn from them demonstrate a small regime in which it supplies no adaptive ordering and correctly falls back to uniform probabilities.

The fixed temperature and 0.20 uniform mixture bound concentration but also limit steering when influence differences are weak. Among heterogeneous profiles the smallest probability span is only 0.00013128212672389866, so activation need not imply a practically large allocation change for every anchor.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. It establishes execution and positive aggregate configured and realized importance lift across the five formal task sessions, but not cross-seed stability, multi-seed score benefit, or transfer to other SeqFlow representations and objectives.

applicability_conditions: The fixed SeqFlow must continue to exactly encode and inverse-decode objective-session molecules, because TACS estimates block importance by bounded interventions on an evaluated anchor's existing latent blocks.

Eligible token blocks must have heterogeneous anchor-specific structural influence: perturbing some blocks must change more of the inverse-decoded anchor sequence than perturbing others, so adaptive probabilities can differ meaningfully from uniform sampling.

Representation-level block influence must be a useful proxy for producing distinct local molecules from high-scoring evaluated anchors; the mechanism does not claim that influence alone identifies objective-improving chemistry.

The bounded probability floor keeps every eligible block reachable, so the change remains applicable when the importance estimate is noisy or when multi-block interactions matter, but it may underperform when single-block interventions are uninformative about joint perturbations.

The extra batched inverse decodes used to estimate per-anchor importance must remain feasible under the supplied runtime profile; no additional oracle calls, corpus retrieval, online representation training, or evaluator-side information is required.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if anchor-rounds with non-tied TACS importance still configure uniform eligible-block probabilities, or if their aggregate probability-weighted and realized selected-block importance fails to exceed the corresponding uniform-selection baseline; a lower score with positive importance lift would instead mean the mechanism activated but was not useful.
research_intent.implementation_change: Change only token-block selection inside _fresh_candidate_pool. Once per proposal round, use the frozen SeqFlow inverse path to make seeded single-block interventions for each eligible block of each current evaluated anchor, compare the resulting token sequence with that anchor, and derive an anchor-specific pointwise-mutual-information importance score. Convert those scores through a temperature-controlled softmax mixed with a fixed uniform probability floor, then pass the resulting probabilities to the existing without-replacement block draw. Keep anchor ranking, selected-block count, displacement distribution and magnitude, trust radii, duplicate and validity rejection, candidate-pool bounds, exact latent GP, Thompson acquisition, feedback updates, protocol, and all fallbacks unchanged, and emit the registered importance-lift diagnostic.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace uniform token-block choice with Token-level Adaptive Candidate Sampling: estimate which eligible SeqFlow blocks most strongly control each evaluated anchor's inverse-decoded token sequence, then preferentially perturb those high-importance blocks while preserving bounded nonzero sampling support for every eligible block. This should spend more of the fixed proposal work on structurally effective local coordinates and expose a more distinct de novo pool to the unchanged Thompson selector.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-5e9392f126c0 uniformly sampled all eligible token blocks even though its seed-0 proposal logs show that 335,178 of 365,802 latent points (91.63%) inverse-decoded to the unchanged anchor, only 24,721 points (6.76%) entered a unique valid acquisition pool, and 66 of 145 rounds reached the 4,096-attempt guard. The waste was most severe on median_2, where 99,697 of 104,863 points were unchanged, unique-pool yield was 4.09%, only 7 of 127 recorded anchor transitions improved their source anchor, and terminal Top-1 rose by just 0.02328; the method therefore needs to direct the same bounded perturbations toward token blocks that actually influence the decoded molecule.
